name: CropHarvest: Global Dataset for Agricultural Land Cover Classification
description: A diverse, globally distributed dataset for agricultural land cover classification and crop-type mapping curated by NASA Harvest and the University of Maryland. Spans 93,607 globally distributed crop and non-crop geographic points across 2,279 distinct 0.10° x 0.10° tiles and 35 countries. Combines multi-temporal satellite imagery from Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1, Landsat 8, and ERA5 weather reanalysis to enable robust multi-modal machine learning for food security.
